exceptions.useWhen: Graph is supporting context rather than the primary exploration surface
The page is an interactive tool or studio where controls and canvas must remain visible together
A guide has no meaningful graph or the graph would duplicate a simple linear reading path

compactPcMode.purpose: Reduce graph density without reintroducing desktop scrolling
considerWhenAny: node labels repeatedly wrap beyond 2 lines
rules: keep all lanes visible without horizontal scroll at width >= 641px
hide secondary node metadata until selection
reduce chip and node padding before reducing font size
preserve selected-node detail and relationship meaning
never replace the full graph with an unrelated summary
